history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, medium shot of a young man playing a red electric guitar in a dimly lit recording studio. He is wearing a brown baseball cap with the brim pulled low, obscuring his eyes, and a dark brown hooded sweatshirt. His hair is pulled back into a small bun. A subtle tattoo of a musical note is visible on the back of his neck. The guitar is a classic Fender-style electric, with a red body and a cream-colored pickguard. His hands are actively playing the fretboard and strumming the strings.

The background is a typical home recording studio setup. The walls are covered with dark brown, geometric acoustic foam panels, creating a textured, somewhat abstract pattern. To the right, an air conditioning unit is mounted high on the wall, with a bright orange cloth hanging from it. In front of the musician, a small white MIDI keyboard with black and white keys is visible, along with some audio equipment and what appears to be a monitor screen. Red curtains hang on the left side of the frame. The lighting is moody and atmospheric, with warm tones from the acoustic panels and some cooler, more artificial lighting from the studio equipment. The overall mood is one of focused creativity and musical immersion. The color palette is dominated by warm browns, reds, and oranges, with accents of black and cream.
